stories.title: FBI raids Eric Swalwell’s property, seizes devices at airport in sexual misconduct investigation
stories.summary:
Federal agents confronted former California Representative Eric Swalwell at San Francisco International Airport on Saturday and seized his electronic devices. The action was part of an ongoing federal criminal investigation into allegations of sexual misconduct.

According to sources familiar with the probe, FBI agents presented Swalwell with a search warrant upon his arrival in California. They confiscated his cell phone and other digital materials as key evidence for the case.

The following day, investigators expanded their efforts by raiding Swalwell’s home in Washington. The coordinated law enforcement actions mark a significant escalation in the federal sex crime investigation.

stories.title: Darline Graham Nordone attempts to quell backlash over Taiwan question: ‘I don’t speak politician’
stories.summary:
Sen. Darline Graham Nordone (R-SC) is attempting to defuse criticism after a debate remark in which she said she was “not that informed” on national security, including questions about Taiwan.

During Tuesday’s Republican runoff debate against Rep. Ralph Norman for the Senate seat previously held by her late brother, Lindsey Graham, Graham Nordone drew ridicule for the comment. She later told Fox News’ “Hannity” that she is not a career politician and does not “speak politician,” adding that she was simply being honest.

The remarks have fueled debate over her readiness to serve in a role involving national security policy, with opponents highlighting the Taiwan question as evidence of gaps in her knowledge. Supporters frame her candor as refreshing rather than disqualifying.

stories.title: Seven First Nations Australians tell us their worries and hopes for future generations – video
stories.summary:
Seven First Nations Australians share their worries and hopes for future generations in a new video from The Guardian Australia.

The piece highlights East Arnhem Land, described as one of the last strongholds of Aboriginal culture in Australia. It is home to the Yolngu people, who maintain one of the oldest continuous cultures on Earth.

The land is fully owned and managed by traditional owners under inalienable Aboriginal freehold title, meaning it can never be bought or sold.

Each year, the Yolngu host the Garma festival, described as Australia's largest Indigenous political and cultural gathering. The event brings together First Nations leaders from around the country.

stories.summary:
Insomniac Games is adapting its successful Spider-Man formula for Marvel’s Wolverine, a character whose violent nature may challenge the studio's established approach. The developer has previously created games so closely aligned with their protagonists that they influenced film adaptations, including this year's Spider-Man movie.

The transition to Wolverine requires adjusting the gameplay and narrative tone to fit a more cutthroat superhero. While the studio's format worked well for Spider-Man, it may not naturally suit a character defined by sharp claws and aggressive combat.

stories.title: Lobsters and acidic seas: can shellfish help neutralise one of the greatest threats to the ocean?
stories.summary:
Researchers are testing whether adding alkalis to seawater can help neutralize ocean acidification by increasing the water's capacity to absorb carbon dioxide. The experiments focus on crustaceans, including lobsters, to determine if these chemical changes pose risks to marine life.

The research is particularly relevant in New England, where lobster fishing and consumption are culturally significant. Lobster rolls remain a popular summer dish, though their price has become a point of debate among consumers.

However, the study faces uncertainty due to a halt in funding under the Trump administration. This financial interruption threatens to disrupt ongoing efforts to understand how ocean alkalinity enhancement might mitigate one of the greatest threats facing marine ecosystems.

stories.title: Frustrated GP patients hang up as Yorkshire accent baffles AI receptionist
stories.summary:
Patients in South Yorkshire are reporting frustration with an AI GP receptionist that struggles to understand local accents, according to a health watchdog.

Healthwatch Rotherham said several practices in the area have introduced an automated assistant named Emma. The system is designed to handle patient inquiries and manage appointments without human intervention.

The AI firm behind the chatbot claims it supports 17 languages. However, Healthwatch Rotherham noted that the system has difficulty processing local "twangs" and broad Yorkshire dialects.

As a result, some patients have reportedly hung up during calls when the receptionist failed to comprehend their speech. The watchdog highlighted these issues as part of its ongoing monitoring of digital health services in the region.

stories.title: Relax, everyone: Elon Musk has a mantra to make the climate crisis go away | Emma Brockes
stories.summary:
Elon Musk has proposed a new mantra for addressing the climate crisis, suggesting that humanity should focus on moving energy production off-planet. According to the SpaceX boss, this approach aligns with the Kardashev scale, a theoretical framework used to measure a civilization's level of technological advancement.

The proposal offers a conceptual shift in how people might think about environmental challenges. Instead of focusing solely on immediate terrestrial solutions, Musk’s idea encourages looking toward space-based energy systems as a long-term strategy for sustainability.
